# Vendored Three.js r128

`three.r128.min.js` was extracted byte-for-byte from `IndyGP_Phase1.html` by
`scaffold.js`. It is the exact UMD bundle the prototype shipped, kept here as
an offline provenance artefact.

The workspace consumes `three@0.128.0` from the registry so the bundler can
tree-shake it and `@types/three@0.128.0` can supply declarations. Both resolve
to the same revision, so runtime behaviour is unchanged.

Nothing in this folder is imported by the build.
